# Five Robot XApp SDK

Device theme (.xtheme / 240x240): read docs/theme-ai.md first; then only needed docs/themes/development.md, format.md and acceptance.md. Theme context revision is independent of the XApp SDK release. docs/themes/index.json pins public data schemas, packaging validators and authoring tools; no private firmware/renderer/artwork/font binaries are required or provided. tools/theme/pack.py validates before output; it never operates devices. Do not run the XApp workflow for a theme. Copyable one-line entry: docs/themes/prompt.txt.

Independent native firmware (.bin / ESP-IDF): read docs/native-firmware-ai.md first.
It routes to ten on-demand topics (docs/native/index.json): hardware, power-input, build, display-ui, audio, network-storage, performance, images-recovery, troubleshooting, provenance.
Read hardware/power-input/build once, then only relevant topics. Local: python tools/native_context.py --topics display-ui,audio. The reader has no network/model/device calls; hashes pin one documentation set. This is a source-backed contract, not an accepted standalone BSP. Do not run the XApp workflow for a native task. XApp native-ui templates remain XApps.

SDK 2026.11.05.4-candidate; API 2.17; package format 1. Preserve API<=2.16 imports and layouts.
New BLE session/beacon, UDP/WS, UTC and native8k playback need matched API2.16 firmware.
Release-ready artifacts are separate from public availability: follow the official index and docs/releases.md. AMBE is experimental/default OFF; DMR0.1.1 is a connection-test app without voice calls; published history stays immutable. See docs/api-2.16.md for capability and experimental limits.

Official index: https://site.flashbot5.com/developer/v1/index.json
GitHub: https://github.com/LightningFive/five-robot-app-docs
Gitee: https://gitee.com/yorium/five-robot-app-docs

Mandatory XApp AI execution entry: docs/ai-workflow.md
Use workflow.py prepare/build. Read only the returned capability context and target template first.
Full stable rules remain in docs/ai-reference.md; do not load all of them for every APP.
One source-filled JSON request can use workflow.py run. Tool-owned model calls: zero.
See docs/workflow-automation.md. Do not repeat manual checks already covered by build.
Implementation scope and evidence boundaries: docs/ai-rules-rollout.md
Shared tool and optional asset dependency cache: docs/environment-cache.md
Default templates have cached licensed launcher assets; no third-party Python packages are needed.
tools/check_product.py checks final package presentation; build enables it by default.
Do not treat static, host, final-WASM preview or hardware results as interchangeable.

Pin one immutable release; reuse verified local SDK/toolchain files.
Use actual API contracts, final package checks and separate static/stub/runtime/hardware evidence.
Product input roles differ from historical CONFIRM/BACK ABI names; follow the documented target profile.
No invented SDK declarations, implicit firmware/API edits, credential disclosure or automatic device operations.
User needs and authorization govern task scope.

API2.17 is an isolated integration candidate until the official index publishes it.
New ws_open_ex/WSS, bounded HTTP+WS headers, http_release and Opus V2 require matched firmware.
API>=2.17 APPs explicitly wifi_start after preparing large codec state; older APP startup stays unchanged.
Read docs/api-2.17.md and the opus/net/http/stream capability contexts before writing voice code.
Theme package1 supports classic ABI5/FNT3 Title common-name banks and native ABI4/NSC1v3.
Read tools/theme/context.py --topics development,format,indexed-fonts,classic-fonts; fonts stay on Flash.
Do not claim desktop placeholder codecs, package validation or host pixels as device audio/performance proof.
